Title: Cyrena.PlatformIO - PlatformIOPlugin (Platform)
Summary: Semantic Kernel plugin for PlatformIO development. Exposes AI-callable functions for creating C/C++ files in a structured feature-based layout. Consolidated into three file creation functions (create_h, create_c, create_cpp) each accepting optional featureFolderId and subDirectory parameters. Also supports feature creation and environment queries.
Content:
## Cyrena.PlatformIO.Services.Platform

Internal Semantic Kernel plugin exposing AI-callable functions for PlatformIO development. Registered by `PlatformIOBuilder` via `options.Plugins.AddFromType<Platform>()`.

**Dependencies:** `IChatMessageService`, `IEnvironmentController`, `IDevelopPlanService`

**Valid subDirectory values:** `definitions`, `actions`, `internals` (case-insensitive). Any other value returns an error `ToolResult`.

**src/ restriction:** The `definitions` sub-directory is only valid in `include/`. `src/` features have `actions` and `internals` only. Passing `subDirectory = "definitions"` to `create_c` or `create_cpp` returns an error `ToolResult`.

### Kernel Functions

#### `get_environment_info`

Returns the current PlatformIO environment properties (board, framework, platform, etc.).

- **Returns:** `Dictionary<string, string?>` — all key/value pairs from the active environment's `platformio.ini` section
- **Error case:** Returns `{"ERROR": "No active environments"}` if none selected

#### `create_feature`

Creates a feature folder in both `include/` and `src/` with structured sub-folders.

- **Parameters:** `name` (string) — feature name, e.g. `'motor_control'`
- **Returns:** `ToolResult<DevelopFolder>` — the include feature folder
- **Normalization:** lowercased, spaces → underscores

Creates:
- `include/{feature}/definitions/` — for type definitions, constants, structs, enums
- `include/{feature}/actions/` — for action function declarations (public API)
- `include/{feature}/internals/` — for internal helper declarations
- `src/{feature}/actions/` — for action function implementations
- `src/{feature}/internals/` — for internal helper implementations

Note: `src/{feature}/definitions/` is **not** created. Type definitions belong in `include/` only.

#### `create_h`

Creates a header file (`.h`) in `include/`.

- **Parameters:**
  - `name` (string, required) — file name without extension
  - `featureFolderId` (string?, optional) — e.g. `'include_motor_control'`. Pass `null` for root `include/`.
  - `subDirectory` (string?, optional) — `'definitions'`, `'actions'`, or `'internals'`. Pass `null` to create directly in the feature folder. Ignored when `featureFolderId` is `null`.
- **Returns:** `ToolResult<DevelopFile>`
- **Error cases:**
  - Invalid `subDirectory` → error result
  - `featureFolderId` not starting with `'include_'` → error result
  - Feature or sub-folder not found → error result

#### `create_c`

Creates a C file (`.c`) in `src/`.

- **Parameters:**
  - `name` (string, required) — file name without extension
  - `featureFolderId` (string?, optional) — e.g. `'src_motor_control'`. Pass `null` for root `src/`.
  - `subDirectory` (string?, optional) — `'actions'` or `'internals'`. `'definitions'` is **not valid** in `src/`. Pass `null` to create directly in the feature folder. Ignored when `featureFolderId` is `null`.
- **Returns:** `ToolResult<DevelopFile>`
- **Error cases:**
  - Invalid `subDirectory` → error result
  - `subDirectory = "definitions"` → error result (definitions only in `include/`)
  - `featureFolderId` not starting with `'src_'` → error result
  - Feature or sub-folder not found → error result

#### `create_cpp`

Creates a C++ file (`.cpp`) in `src/`.

- **Parameters:**
  - `name` (string, required) — file name without extension
  - `featureFolderId` (string?, optional) — e.g. `'src_motor_control'`. Pass `null` for root `src/`.
  - `subDirectory` (string?, optional) — `'actions'` or `'internals'`. `'definitions'` is **not valid** in `src/`. Pass `null` to create directly in the feature folder. Ignored when `featureFolderId` is `null`.
- **Returns:** `ToolResult<DevelopFile>`
- **Error cases:**
  - Invalid `subDirectory` → error result
  - `subDirectory = "definitions"` → error result (definitions only in `include/`)
  - `featureFolderId` not starting with `'src_'` → error result
  - Feature or sub-folder not found → error result

### File ID Generation

- Root files: `{dir}_{ext}_{name}` → e.g., `include_h_my_header`, `c_my_module`, `cpp_my_module`
- Feature root (no subDirectory): `{featureId}_{ext}_{name}` → e.g., `include_motor_h_motor`
- Feature sub-folder: `{featureId}_{subDirectory}_{ext}_{name}` → e.g., `include_motor_definitions_h_motor_types`, `src_motor_actions_c_motor_actions`

### Design Notes

- The AI **cannot** create files in `lib/`, `data/`, `components/`, `managed_components/`, or modify `platformio.ini`
- The AI **cannot** create `.h` files in `src/` (read-only if present)
- The AI **cannot** create `.c`/`.cpp` files in `include/` (only `.h` allowed)
- The AI **cannot** create files in `src/{feature}/definitions/` — type definitions belong in `include/` only
- `create_h` validates that `featureFolderId` starts with `include_`; `create_c`/`create_cpp` validate `src_`
- All functions return `ToolResult<DevelopFile>` with success/failure and existing file detection
- Duplicate file creation returns the existing file without error
- Invalid `subDirectory` values return an error `ToolResult` with message listing valid values
